page.overview:
Who is Coelurus?

Coelurus would have preferred small, easily captured prey. It is possible that it was shy and avoided contact with heavier animals, as it could not have been very strong. It is quite likely that its preferred escape method would have been a rapid retreat from any threat. Coelurus was likely adapted for hunting small prey. Due to its small size, it may have been predated by larger dinosaurs.

There is still discussion among researchers as to the identification of the type specimen. The most recent detailed study suggests that the four specimens, which were found in the same quarry site, are actually just one individual. It was also once suggested that Coelurus and Ornitholestes was the same creature, but a recent study concluded that they are in fact separate genera. Coelurus is one of the fastest dinosaurs ever known.

Coelurus appears on the Jurassic Park Institute. It is light green in color, and is shown chasing after an unidentified lizard.

Coelurus was cloned by Masrani Global Corporation for their theme park, Jurassic World. The attraction the dinosaur resided is unknown.
